Profiler.Title: Native preview profiler
Profiler.HistoryHelp: Exclusive work between received snapshots, not frame time. Click to inspect; wheel to zoom. Time axis is local reception time.
Profiler.SampleTip: Snapshot {0} | received +{1} s | exclusive work {2} ms
Profiler.CostHelp: Top 64 exclusive costs, ranked by duration. These bars show cost, NOT thread execution order. Click a bar for details.
Profiler.DetailHelp: Click a colored cost bar to inspect its node, call count and timings.
Profiler.DetailNumbers:
Calls: {0}
Exclusive: {1} ms
Inclusive: {2} ms
Mean inclusive / call: {3} ms
Profiler.DetailRange:
Cumulative minimum / call: {0} ms
Cumulative maximum / call: {1} ms
Profiler.NoActivity: No completed work in this interval.
Profiler.CapabilityNotice: Engine editor, runtime and viewer roles are reported by each peer. Operations require explicit capabilities, not a role or operating system. Capture controls are sent requests, not acknowledgments.
Profiler.Disconnected: No preview clients connected. Disconnected clients and their telemetry are removed.
Profiler.SelectPeer: Select a connected client. The previously selected client may have disconnected.
Profiler.Requested: Last sent request: capture {0}, interval {1} ms, nodes {2}, accessors {3}. Not acknowledged.
Profiler.NotRequested: No capture request sent by this tool for this connection.
Profiler.Units: All durations below are milliseconds, converted explicitly from native nanoseconds (ns ÷ 1,000,000). Empty node IDs denote aggregate events.
Profiler.ProfileUnsupported: Profiling unavailable: this peer has not advertised profiling.
Profiler.ProfileEmpty: Waiting for a complete native profile snapshot.
Profiler.Snapshot: Complete snapshot: program {0}, snapshot {1}, metrics {2}, dropped events {3}.
Profiler.Pending: New snapshot pages are pending; only the previous complete snapshot is displayed.
Profiler.WatchHelp: Watch at most 64 distinct node GUIDs, comma or space separated. An empty list clears watches. Values come from the native evaluator, not the editor graph.
Profiler.ValuesUnsupported: Value feedback unavailable: this peer has not advertised values.
Profiler.ValueSnapshot: Program {0}, evaluation time {1} seconds, returned nodes {2}.
Profiler.Sent: Control sent. Waiting for native feedback; no acknowledgment is implied.
Profiler.InvalidControl: Invalid control. Use interval 100–5000 ms and at most 64 distinct nonempty node GUIDs.
Profiler.SendFailed: Control could not be sent. Check the client connection and advertised capabilities.
